disclaimer: This registry is an educational starting point. Source presence and freshness metadata do not establish legal applicability, compliance, certification, or completeness.

sources.title: AI Risk Management Framework
sources.publisher: US National Institute of Standards and Technology
sources.usageNote: Reviewed AI RMF 1.0 (NIST AI 100-1, January 2023). NIST announces revision work; no successor is inferred from that notice. Voluntary risk-management context, not certification. Review record: docs/source-review-2026-10-12.html.

sources.title: Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework: Generative Artificial Intelligence Profile
sources.publisher: US National Institute of Standards and Technology
sources.usageNote: Reviewed NIST AI 600-1 (26 July 2024), a voluntary companion profile to AI RMF 1.0. Use context-specific testing and accountable review; neither source presence nor a PALO threshold proves effectiveness. Review record: docs/source-review-2026-10-12.html.

sources.title: ISO/IEC 42001 Artificial intelligence management system
sources.usageNote: Catalog metadata is linked for status checking; this starter library does not reproduce or certify conformance to the standard.

sources.title: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (Artificial Intelligence Act)
sources.publisher: Official Journal of the European Union
sources.usageNote: Read the official act with consolidated CELEX 02024R1689-20260727 and Regulation 2026/1744. Actor, scope, exceptions and transition dates require case-specific legal review. PALO competence tests are organizational controls, not a statutory guarantee of individual proficiency. Review record: docs/source-review-2026-10-12.html.

sources.title: OECD AI Principles
sources.publisher: Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development
sources.usageNote: Use as a principles reference and verify any jurisdiction-specific obligations separately.

sources.title: OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications 2026
sources.usageNote: The repository pins the 2026 v1.0 PDF dated 4 August 2026. Its revision history retains a publication-date placeholder, so reverify the official project page before external assurance. Use it as an informative test catalog, not as compliance or certification.

sources.title: Guidelines on Article 50 transparency obligations for providers and deployers of certain AI systems
sources.usageNote: Reviewed C(2026) 5054 final annex (20 July 2026). These non-binding guidelines interpret Article 50; distinguish provider/deployer roles, disclosures, marks and exceptions. The synthetic-content transparency Code is separate from the GPAI Code. Review record: docs/source-review-2026-10-12.html.

sources.title: General-Purpose AI Code of Practice
sources.usageNote: Reviewed the Code published 10 July 2025; its index was updated 7 October 2026. Voluntary provider route; Safety and Security concerns systemic-risk models. PALO integrator controls do not automatically impose provider duties. Signing and conformity need separate evidence. Review record: docs/source-review-2026-10-12.html.

sources.title: ISO/IEC 42005:2025 AI system impact assessment
sources.usageNote: Catalog metadata supports source-status checks. PALO does not reproduce the licensed standard or certify an impact assessment against it.

sources.title: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines 2.2
sources.usageNote: Use WCAG 2.2 for interface and perceivable-output testing. Product, sector and jurisdiction-specific accessibility obligations remain separately applicable.

sources.title: Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (General Data Protection Regulation)
sources.publisher: Official Journal of the European Union
sources.usageNote: Use the current official text with qualified privacy review. PALO does not determine lawful basis, controller or processor status, or data-subject-rights compliance.

sources.title: PALO External Agentic Evidence Contract
sources.usageNote: Use as the canonical PALO normalization and governance boundary for optional external agentic evidence; it does not accept or validate any imported claim.

sources.title: Rogue AI Tracker methodology
sources.usageNote: Reviewed an unversioned methodology snapshot: AI-assisted capability scoring, not harm or prevalence measurement. PALO retains optional metadata-only context and a disabled-by-default adapter. No incident, provider score or deployment decision is validated by this review. Review record: docs/source-review-2026-10-12.html.
